design_philosophy.inspiration: Salesforce CRM layout and usability, without copying branding
design_philosophy.spacing_strategy: Control Room Grid. Dense, compact spacing. gap-4, tight data tables, explicit borders.
design_philosophy.surface_strategy: Grid Borders & Neumorphism variant. Flat backgrounds, 1px solid borders, max 8px border radius. No heavy shadows.

body.style: Precise, highly legible at small sizes, data-friendly.

cards.classes: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md shadow-sm p-4

buttons.primary: bg-[#026AA2] text-white hover:bg-[#025684] rounded shadow-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded shadow-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-600 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-left

inputs.classes: w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#026AA2]/20 focus:border-[#026AA2] bg-white transition-all shadow-sm

sidebar.wrapper: w-64 bg-white border-r border-slate-200 flex flex-col h-screen shrink-0
sidebar.link: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 mx-2 my-1 rounded-md text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors
sidebar.link_active: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 mx-2 my-1 rounded-md text-sm font-medium bg-blue-50 text-[#026AA2] transition-colors

top_nav.wrapper: h-16 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between px-6 shrink-0 sticky top-0 z-40

badges.base_classes: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

pages_to_build: Lead Detail (Overview, Notes, Call Logs, Activity History tabs)

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio. Hover states must have explicitly defined text colors.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a strict layout: Sidebar on left, TopNav on top. Main content area scrolls independently.
DO NOT use emojis. Only use lucide-react icons.
DO NOT use purple/violet generic SaaS gradients.
Enforce specific colored status badges as mapped in colors.status_badges.
Use Work Sans for Headings and IBM Plex Sans for Body. Import these from Google Fonts.
Implement tables with clear borders, hover effects, and a highly professional 'Salesforce Lightning' data-density feel.
